summary: Columbus Acquisition Corp (a SPAC) filed an 8-K regarding a $100,000 unsecured promissory note issued to target WISeSat.Space Corp. to cover Monthly Extension Fees (50% per deposit) deposited into the trust account, extending the deadline to complete a business combination to January 22, 2027. The note is non-interest-bearing and payable upon termination of the November 2025 Business Combination Agreement among WISeSat.Space Holdings Corp., Merger Sub, and WISeKey International. No price per share, premium, or advisor is specified. The filing shows ongoing SPAC extension mechanics; watch for shareholder vote on the de-SPAC transaction or, if not completed, trust liquidation.
